_comment: Cards whose official pages collect.ts fetches daily. Each source is fetched twice (independent requests). patterns: JS regex source (case-insensitive, all matches must agree) + capture-group -> tracked field map; optional transforms (days_to_months). render:true = headless system Chrome (textContent, scripts/styles removed); wait/settle_ms for Amex business pages that never go network-idle. hold_only:true = fetched as evidence, never auto-applied (page can't be parsed reliably). A fetch that redirects to a different page fails. Cards flagged by the expiry check (expired / <=30 days) that are not listed here are auto-added hold-only from their own official source URLs. Cards closed to new applicants (status "discontinued" or discontinued: true) are never listed or auto-added.
